_schema.status: draft pools for PoC city naming; not SSOT
_schema.purpose: Names the engine gives to cities a JAC house founds after its capital. Each house lists its own domain (japan-1534-start.json province_allocations) first, then neighbouring areas; 'shared' (the old provinces) is appended to every house as the last resort before the engine would borrow another civilization's names.

fields.ja: Japanese display name (katakana for Ainu place names as recorded in early modern sources)
fields.kana: reading; English (Hepburn without macrons) and Russian (Polivanov) are generated from it. Words separated by a space
fields.province: old province (or region for Ryukyu, Amami and Ezo)
fields.kind: castle, town, temple, shrine, port, post (post station), estate (shoen), gusuku, kotan, province
fields.source: ja.wikipedia.org article checked on 2026-09-30 through the MediaWiki API: exists, is not a disambiguation page
fields.reading_checked: true when the article's lead contains the reading; false entries (Ainu names under modern municipality articles, a few castles) still need review

_schema.rules: No name may repeat across houses, the shared pool, the 22 capitals, the 56 map cities or the official CIVILIZATION_JAPAN list (tests/test_city_names.py).
